autoInvalidate <- reactiveTimer(5000, session)


output$younggen <- renderChart({
  observe({
         autoInvalidate()
         print("Loading new data")
   })
  autoInvalidate()
  ydata <- ydata + 1
  younggen <- loadeddata(younggen)
  younggen  <- transform(younggen,date=as.character(date))
  yg <- mPlot(x = "date", y = c("eden", "survivor"), type = "Line", data = younggen)
  yg$addParams(height = 300, dom = 'young')
  yg$set(title="Younggen")
  yg$set( pointSize = 0 )
  yg$set( hideHover = "auto" )
  return(yg)
  })
